verdict.rationale: Jan is a chat-first, ChatGPT-style app (jan-gh-12, jan-docs-3) whose agent mode takes natural-language tasks and carries them out autonomously across files, commands and web research (jan-docs-13, jan-docs-14). MCP tools and browser automation extend this, with inline approval of tool calls (jan-gh-5, jan-docs-15, jan-docs-9). Missing for 10: evidence that the app's own functions (model downloads, settings, assistant configuration) can be driven by natural-language commands rather than UI clicks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous task claims.
